name: Masaki Minato
source:
The only daughter of "Masaki Guesthouse" where the protagonist stays. A cheerful, energetic girl who takes good care of guests. When not busy, she personally wakes the protagonist every morning. Mentioning cooking might make her playfully throw a tray your way.
[Translated from Japanese by DeepSeek]
